RESIDENTIAL RATES
STANDARD RATE
These rates are for individually metered residential premises, including apartment units
and domestic out-buildings. Rate Codes* E01 E03
Effective February 1, 2026 (City, Town, and Village) (Rural)
Basic monthly charge $31.16 $31.16
Energy charge (¢/kWh) 15.476¢ 15.476¢
*The rates herein defined are net and do not include any taxes or surcharges, which may
lawfully be imposed by or at the request of any municipal, provincial or federal authority.
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge.
RATE APPLICATION FOR BULK METERED ACCOUNTS
The basic monthly charge applicable to the residential rates in the community,
multiplied by the number of units in the apartment block or stalls in the trailer park.
Note: The bulk metered rate option is closed to new customers.

RESIDENTIAL RATES
DIESEL RATE
These rates are for individually metered residential premises, including apartment units,
supplied by diesel generation. Rate Code* E04
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic monthly charge $31.16
Energy Charge First 650 kWh/month (¢/kWh) 15.476¢
Balance (¢/kWh) 60.416¢
*The rates herein defined are net and do not include any taxes or surcharges, which may
lawfully be imposed by or at the request of any municipal, provincial or federal authority.
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge.
